name: Giving To Others In Need
overview: Scripture emphasizes the importance of generously giving to those in need, urging believers not to withhold good when it is within their power to help (Proverbs 3:27). A generous heart that shares with the poor is promised blessings and provision, while withholding aid brings curses (Proverbs 22:9; 28:27). God calls His people to faithful giving, including tithes, assuring that such obedience will result in abundant blessings (Malachi 3:10). Jesus teaches a spirit of open-handedness toward those who ask or borrow, promising that giving will be rewarded with overflowing blessings measured back to the giver (Matthew 5:42; Luke 6:38).
